### Ran Playwright code

```js
await (async(page)=>{await page.reload({waitUntil:'domcontentloaded'});await page.getByRole('button',{name:'목록 수집 시작',exact:true}).waitFor();const channels=await page.getByRole('switch').evaluateAll(es=>es.map(e=>({name:e.getAttribute('aria-label'),checked:e.getAttribute('aria-checked')})));await page.getByRole('button',{name:'목록 수집 시작',exact:true}).click();await page.getByRole('heading',{name:'본문 수집 전에 키워드를 정리합니다',exact:true}).waitFor();await page.getByText('수집된 목록이 없습니다',{exact:true}).scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();await page.screenshot({path:page.qaDir+'QA-EDGE-001.png'});return {time:new Date().toISOString(),url:page.url(),channels,dom:await page.locator('body').innerText(),status:await(await page.request.get('http://localhost:8010/crawl/'+page.qaSessions.main['QA 빈 결과'].sid+'/status')).json()};})(page);
```
### Page
- Page URL: http://localhost:3010/pipeline/crawling
### Modal state
- ["beforeunload" dialog with message ""]: can be handled by browser_handle_dialog
